name: SK Rytm Track
about: Overbridge for the Elektron Analog Rytm MKII: plays one of the AR's 12 USB outputs (Main L/R, BD, SD, RS/CP, BT, LT, MT/HT, CH/OH, CY/CB, Input) on its own MPC track, sample-aligned with the others, so each gets MPC's effects, sends and sidechains. Optional MIDI to the AR. Needs the AR in Overbridge mode on the MPC's USB host port.
